***Connection Recognized by TIME for Employee Experience, Financial Performance, and ESG Transparency***


MERRIMACK, N.H.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 9, 2026-- Connection (PC Connection, Inc.; NASDAQ:[CNXN](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.connection.com%2F&esheet=54568117&newsitemid=20260709817506&lan=en-US&anchor=CNXN&index=1&md5=b0b1cd4116c5d7d81b3d7d2bd2a28c8b) ), a leading provider of information technology solutions to business, government, healthcare, and education markets, is pleased to announce that it has been named one of America’s Best Companies by TIME, a prestigious recognition presented in collaboration with Statista. Connection earned the #449 spot on the list of 1000 companies for 2026.


The annual ranking highlights top-performing U.S. organizations based on a comprehensive, data-driven evaluation across three key dimensions:


- **Employee Satisfaction:** Based on large-scale employee survey data assessing culture, compensation, and workplace conditions
- **Financial Performance:** Analysis of revenue growth, profitability, and long-term stability
- **Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG):** Evaluation of sustainability, social responsibility, and governance practices


“We are honored to be recognized by TIME as one of America’s Best Companies,” said Tim McGrath, President and Chief Executive Officer of Connection. “This achievement reflects the strength of our people, our commitment to delivering industry-leading technology solutions and services to our customers, and our focus on building a responsible, high-performing organization.”


Connection continues to invest in its people, expand its capabilities in emerging technologies, and prioritize sustainable business practices that deliver long-term value for customers, partners, shareholders, and communities.


The research methodology and full list of America’s Best Companies 2026 is published on the[TIME website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftime.com%2Farticle%2F2026%2F07%2F09%2Famericas-best-companies-2026%2F&esheet=54568117&newsitemid=20260709817506&lan=en-US&anchor=TIME+website&index=2&md5=f65e1b2bb65ccbd9b004c66df76c18d5) .
